contrast.estimand: pre-intervention T1 Crohn's disease active-or-remission minus control stool response

design_boundary: Only T1 stool acquisitions enter; later Mediterranean-diet timepoints are excluded.
Three technical files are median-collapsed within each participant before inference.
Active and remission Crohn's disease are combined only for this broad IBD condition-family calibration.
The baseline case-control estimand is observational and has no diet-treatment causal interpretation.
identity_boundary: No complete strict direct-library result is deposited for this MGF, so every entity remains unresolved for primary partitioning.
MZmine matched-lipid names are retained as provisional annotations only and never converted to library-supported identity.
